thesis_paragraphs: The world moves at the speed and cost at which people and goods move. Make a dent in that, and you change how the world works.

Navier builds the vessels and operating infrastructure for high-speed, high-throughput, energy-efficient maritime transportation. Our vessels open new routes; distributed manufacturing scales the fleets; our strategic maritime nodes power and service them — and the network is open to compatible vessels from any manufacturer, all on one standard.

Navier earns recurring revenue on every journey, and every vessel and node added makes the network more valuable. One standardized platform compounding over passenger transport, cargo logistics and defense.

sections.title: Commercial Infrastructure First. Defense on Top.
body: We are a dual-use platform company. Commercial fleets carry the production volume — so defense buys at commercial cost and commercial rate, not bespoke-program cost.

Production capacity exists today across U.S. contract yards — Lyman-Morse (Maine) and Seattle for First-of-Class builds and U.S. programs — with California HQ building NavierOS, foils, and new IP. A flagship U.S. shipyard is planned for 2028, sited for Jones Act and U.S. Navy / NATO production.
Unit cost falls with design and volume, not with spec: the Quanta build is engineered −45% against the first-generation N30, line by line.
